en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1292 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) was asked about performing the supererogatory (nafilah) prayers during the day while traveling.
Imam (as) said: "If it were appropriate to perform the nafilah (supererogatory) prayers during travel, then the obligatory (fardh) prayers would have been completed (in full)”.
